description: Corpus of 15 challenging coding edge cases for verifying agent code generation correctness and adversarial robustness under Mayank's security fuzzer and SteerLM PR gate.

edge_cases.name: off_by_one_boundary
edge_cases.trigger_input: Empty list [] or single-element target at boundary
edge_cases.description: Binary search using while low < high instead of <= and mid calculation that overflows or misses last element.
edge_cases.remediation: Use while low <= high and handle empty sequence guard at entry.

edge_cases.name: missing_null_check
edge_cases.description: Accessing nested dictionary keys directly assuming intermediate dictionaries are never None.
edge_cases.remediation: Use safe traversal helper or explicit isinstance/None validation on each tier.

edge_cases.name: zero_division_guard
edge_cases.trigger_input: values = [] or weights sum to 0 or total_count = 0
edge_cases.description: Calculating weighted mean or percentage without checking if denominator is zero or empty.
edge_cases.remediation: Guard against zero sum/length explicitly, returning fallback default (0.0) or raising ValueError.

edge_cases.name: unbounded_recursion_depth
edge_cases.trigger_input: Circular references or deeply nested structures (depth > 1000)
edge_cases.description: Recursive tree traversal without visited-set cycle detection or maximum depth bound.
edge_cases.remediation: Use an explicit iterative stack with a visited identity set and hard maximum depth limit.

edge_cases.name: embedded_null_byte_unicode
edge_cases.description: Processing filenames or identifiers without stripping embedded null bytes (\x00).
edge_cases.remediation: Strip null bytes and control characters, validate against allowed character set.

edge_cases.name: floating_point_equality
edge_cases.description: Comparing floating point numbers directly using == in financial or threshold checks.
edge_cases.remediation: Use math.isclose() with relative/absolute tolerance, or integer cents / Decimal.

edge_cases.name: mutable_default_argument
edge_cases.trigger_input: Consecutive calls relying on default argument [] or {}
edge_cases.description: Using mutable containers (list, dict, set) as default parameter values.
edge_cases.remediation: Set default to None and initialize a new container inside the function body.

edge_cases.name: regex_catastrophic_backtracking
edge_cases.description: Nested quantifiers without atomic grouping or input length pre-validation causing catastrophic backtracking.
edge_cases.remediation: Simplify regex pattern, use possessive/atomic matching or pre-validate maximum string length.

edge_cases.name: dict_mutation_during_iteration
edge_cases.trigger_input: Modifying or deleting dictionary keys inside a for loop over the dictionary
edge_cases.description: Deleting keys directly from a dictionary while iterating over d.items() or d.keys().
edge_cases.remediation: Iterate over a copy of keys list(d.keys()) or use dictionary comprehension.

edge_cases.name: shallow_vs_deep_copy
edge_cases.trigger_input: Mutating nested dict/list in shallow copied configuration
edge_cases.description: Using dict.copy() or dict() on nested structures: nested objects remain shared references.
edge_cases.remediation: Use copy.deepcopy() for nested state duplication or immutable data models.

edge_cases.name: unclosed_resource_leak
edge_cases.trigger_input: Exceptions thrown before file.close() or socket.close()
edge_cases.description: Opening file or socket descriptors without using context managers (with statement).
edge_cases.remediation: Always use with open(...) as f: context manager to ensure deterministic cleanup.

edge_cases.name: boolean_coercion_trap
edge_cases.description: Calling bool(val) on strings: bool('false') and bool('0') are True in Python.
edge_cases.remediation: Use explicit lookup dictionary mapping known true/false literals.

edge_cases.name: generator_exhaustion
edge_cases.trigger_input: Passing a generator expression (x for x in data) to a two-pass algorithm
edge_cases.description: Iterating over an Iterable twice: if input is a generator, pass 2 sees empty elements.
edge_cases.remediation: Convert to a list if bounded, or use itertools.tee() to clone the iterator.

edge_cases.name: empty_iterable_min_max
edge_cases.trigger_input: Empty list [] or generator where all items are filtered out
edge_cases.description: Calling min() or max() on filtered iterables without specifying default argument.
edge_cases.remediation: Always pass default=None or default value, or check sequence length beforehand.

edge_cases.name: timezone_naive_aware_collision
edge_cases.description: Subtracting timezone-naive datetime from timezone-aware datetime in session/token expiry checks.
edge_cases.remediation: Always normalize timestamps to timezone-aware UTC before performing arithmetic.
